verses.en: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.sm: Eleni. masima, ma ia fifilemu outou ia te outou.” E sa ona aleiao le ava; o le alofa o Iesu i tamaiti; o le faalavelave o le oa Iutaia i tala atu o Ioritana; ona toe faapotopoto mai lea o le motu o tagata ia te ia, ua na toe aʻoaʻo atu foi ia te i latou, faapei ona masani ai.

verses.en: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
verses.sm: Ua o mai faresaio, ua fesili ia te ia, o tofotofo ia te ia, “E tatau ea ina faatea e le tane lana ava?”

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, “Se a le mea ua poloai ai Mose ia te outou?’

verses.en: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o i latou, “Na tuu mai e Mose ia tusia se tusi alei, ma faatea ia te ia.”

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “Ona o le maaa o outou loto, na ia tusi atu ai lena poloaiga ia te outou;

verses.en: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
verses.sm: 6ae peitai talu le amataga o mea na faia, na faia i laua e le Atua o le tane ma le fafine.

verses.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
verses.sm: O le mea lea e tuua ai e le tane lona tama ma lona tina, a e faatasi ma lana ata,

verses.en: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
verses.sm: ona avea lea o i laua ma timo e tasi; O lea e le toe toalua ai i laua, a e peitai ua tino e tasi;

verses.en: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.sm: 0 lenei, oe ua faatasia e le Atua, aua le faate‘aeseeseina e le tagata.”

verses.en: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
verses.sm: Ua toe fesili ane ona soo ia te ia i lena mea i le fale.

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
verses.sm: tt Ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, “Ai se faatea i lana avå, a e fai ava i le tasi, ua mulilua o ia e agaleaga atu ai ia te ia.

verses.en: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
verses.sm: Afai foi e faatea e le fafine lana tane, a e fai ma ava a se tasi, ua mulilua o ia.”

verses.en: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
verses.sm: Ona latou au mai lea o tamaiti ia te ia, ina ia pa“ ane o ia ia te i latou; a ua vavao atu le au soo i e na aumaia.

verses.en: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: A ua silafia e Iesu, ona tiga ai lea o Jona finagalo, ua na fetalai atu foi ja te i latou, “Ina tuu mai ia o tamaiti e o mai ia te au; aua le vavao ia te i latou; aua e faapei o i latou nei o e o i le malo O le Atua.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ai se le talia le malo o le Atua faapei o se tamaitiiti, e le sao lava ia i ai.”

verses.en: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
verses.sm: Ona siitia lea e ia o i latou i ona lima, ua faaee foi ona aao i luga ia te i latou, ma faamanuia ia te i latou.

verses.en: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.sm: Ua maliu ane o ia i le ala, ona momo'e mai ai lea o le tasi, ua tootuli ia te ia, ma fesili mai ia te ia, “Le aʻoaʻo lelei e, se a se mea ou te fala ina ia ou maua ai le ola faavavau?”

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu lesu ia te ia, “Se a le mea e te taʻua mai ai aʻu ua lelei? E leai se tasi e lelei, na o le toatasi lava, o le Atua lea.

verses.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
verses.sm: Ua e iloa tulafono, Aua e te fasioti tagata; qua e te mulilua; aua e te gaoi; aua e te molimau pepelo; aua e te agaleaga; ia e ava i lou tama ma lou tina

w.en: You shall not bear false witness

verses.en: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o ia ia te ia, “Le aʻoaʻo e, ua ou tausia na mea uma, talu ina ou itiiti.”

verses.en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
verses.sm: Ua silasila atu Iesu ia te ia, ua alofa atu ia te ia, ua fetalai atu foi ia te , “E tasi le mea e le o ia te oe. Ina alu ia, faatau atu au mea uma, ma avatu i e ua matitiva, ona e maua lea o le oa i le lagi; i le E sau ai, ma mulimuli mai ia te au.”

verses.en: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
verses.sm: Ona faanoanoa lea o ia ona o lea upu, ua alu ese foi ma le tiga, aua ua tele ana oloa.

verses.en: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.sm: Ona silasila solo lea o Iesu, ua fetalai atu i ona soo, “E matua faigata ona sao atu o e mauoa i le malo o le Atua.”

verses.en: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.sm: Ona ofo ai lea o le au soo i lana fetalaiga. A ua toe tali atu Iesu ia te i latou, “La‘u fanau e, e matuà faigata ona sao atu i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: E faigofie i le kamela ona ui atu i le pu o le au, a e faigata i le mauoa ona sao i le malo o le Atua.”

verses.en: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
verses.sm: Ona latou matua taufaiofo ai lea, ua latou felafolafoai foi, ua faapea, “Afai o lea, o ai se tasi e mafai ona faaolaina?”

verses.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.sm: A ua silasila atu Iesu ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, “E le mafaia e tagata, na o le Atua; aua e mafaia mea uma e le Atua.”

verses.en: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Peteru ia te ia, “Faauta, ua matou tuua mea uma, a e mulimuli atu ia te oe.”

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu, “E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ai se tasi ua ia tuua le fale, po o uso, po o tuafafine, po o le tina, po o le tama, po o le fanau, po o fanua, ona o aʻu ma le tala lelei,

verses.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
verses.sm: e maua lava e ia taisautuaselau i lenei olaga, o fale, ma uso, ma tuafafine, ma tina, ma fanau, ma fanua, atoa foi ma sauaga, a o le ola atali e maua ai le ola faavavau.

verses.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
verses.sm: A e peitai e toatele o e ua muamua e avea ma mulimuli; o e ua mulimuli foi e avea ma muamua.”

verses.en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
verses.sm: Sa i le ala i latou, ua o ae i Ierusalema, o muamua foi Iesu ia te i latou; ua ofo i latou, ua latou mulimuli atu foi ma le mataʻu. Ona toe ave lea e ia le toasefulu ma le toalua, ua taʻu atu ia te i latou mea a oo ia te ia,

verses.en: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, “Faauta, a tatou o ae nei i Ierusalema, e tuuina ai le Atalii o le tagata i le au ositaulaga sili, ma le au tusiupu; latou te faasala ia te ia, ia oti, latou te tuuina atu foi o ia i nuu ese,

verses.en: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.sm: e faatauemu i latou ia te ia, e feanu foi ia te ia, e sasa foi ia te ia, ma fasioti ia te ia; a e toe tu mai o ia i le aso tolu.”

verses.en: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
verses.sm: Ua o mai ia te ia o Iakopo ma Ioane, o atalii o Sepetaio, ua faapea mai, “Le aʻoaʻo e, ua ma manao ina ia e faia mo i maua le mea a ma ole atu ai.”

verses.en: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i laua, “Se a le mea lua te mananao i ai ou te faia ma oulua?”

verses.en: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
verses.sm: Ona la fai mai lea ia te ia, “Ia e tuu mai ia te i maua, ma te nonofo o le tasi i lou itu taumatau, ma le tasi i lou itu tauagavale i lou mamalu.”

verses.en: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te i laua, “Lua te le iloa le mea lua te ole mai ai na. E mafai ea e oulua ona inu i le ipu ou te inu ai; ma ia papatisoina i le papatisoga e papatisoina ai aʻu?”

verses.en: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
verses.sm: Ona la fai mai lea ia te ia, “Ma te mafaia.” Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i laua, “Lua te inu lava i le ipu ou te inu ai; atoa ma le papatisoga e papatisoina ai aʻu e papatisoina ai oulua;

verses.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
verses.sm: a o le nofo i loʻu itu taumatau ma loʻu itu tauagavale, e le o ia te au lea ona avatu, a e tau lava o e ua saunia mo i latou lea mea.”

verses.en: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai le toasefulu, ona tiga ai lea o latou loto ia lakopo ma Ioane.

verses.en: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
verses.sm: A ua valaau atu Iesu ia te i latou, ona faapea atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Ua outou iloa o alii o nuu ese ua aliitai i latou; o e ua sili foi o i latou, ua pule ia te i latou;

verses.en: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
verses.sm: a E le faapea outou; ao se fia sili ia te outou, ia fai o ia ma a outou auauna;

verses.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
verses.sm: 0 se fia muamua foi ia te outou, ia fai o ia ma tautua a owon uma.

verses.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.sm: Aua foi o le Atalii o le tagata na le sau o ia ina ia auauna tagata ia te ia, a e peitai ia auauna o ia, ma foaiina atu lona ola o le togiola mo tagata e toatele.

verses.en: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
verses.sm: Ua oo i latou i Ieriko, o le a tuanai atu foi leriko e ia, atoa ma ona soo, ma le motu o tagata e toatele, a ua nofo mai i le auala o Patimaio le tauaso, le atalii o Timaio, o faatoga i mea mana.

verses.en: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo o ia o i ai Iesu le Nasareta, ona alaga mai ai lea, ua faapea mai, ‘Iesu e, le alo o Tavita, ia e alofa mai ia te au.”

verses.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.sm: Ona matua vavao atu lea o tagata e toatele ia te ia, ina ia faalologo ia; a o ia ua atili ai ona alaga, “Le alo o Tavita e, ia e alofa mai ia te au.”

verses.en: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
verses.sm: Ua tu Iesu, ma fetalai atu ia valaauina o ia; ona latou valaau atu lea i le tauaso, ua faapea atu ia te ia, “la e loto tele, ina tu ia, o loo valaau o ia ia te oe.”

verses.en: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
verses.sm: Ona tiai lea e ia lona ofu, ua tu i luga, ua sau ia Iesu.

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, “Se a se mea e te manao i ai ou te faia ia te oe?” Ona fai mai lea o le tauaso ia te ia, “Raponi e, Ia vaai oʻu nei mata.”

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, “Ina alu ia; o lou faatuatua ua e malolo ai.” Ona vaai loa lea o ona mata; ona mulimuli atu ai lea o ia ia
